competences.description: Swings a giant sword to deal damage and decrease the target's Defense for 2 turns. This attack will deal more damage according to your MAX HP.

effets.description: The target's Defense will be decreased by 70%.

competences.description: Attacks the target additionally 2 times to decrease Attack Power for 2 turns with a 70% chance each if you attack the enemy with decreased Defense on your turn. The damage increases according to your MAX HP. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: The target's Attack Power will be decreased by 50%.

competences.description: Attacks the target additionally to decrease Attack Bar to 0 and grants irresistible provoke for 1 turn if you attack the enemy with no decreased Defense on your turn. The damage increases according to your MAX HP. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: The target is forced to attack the Monster that is provoked.
Bypasses all enemy resistances when applying effects.
